blocked.reason: treehouse v2.3.0's released flake supplies git but not Python, so the non-activating darwin-rebuild build gate fails deterministically in treehouse's own Go tests when the no-mistakes gate runs its Python-dependent script. Upstream fixed the Nix packaging in v3.0.0, but the 3.x line is a separately held major release (see the v3.1.2 entry), so the pin stays at the last reviewed buildable v2.2.0.

treehouse v3.1.2 builds and stays within the reviewed capability, but it is a major release with behavior changes held pending captain adoption: its first use migrates the shared worktree pools' state one way to version 4, return --force refuses to reset a worktree with a live foreign writer, the get subshell becomes a login shell, and get/return add exit status 3 for a retained dirty worktree. Firstmate is validated on 2.x, so the pin stays at v2.2.0 until the captain adopts 3.x.
